description:
Goal
Remove the legacy production path after product-path parity and telemetry proof are complete.

Required removals
- Delete production dependency on SealSemanticClosure, SemanticReady, and SemanticClosed from the backend path.
- Delete production use of root_executable_frontier(root). Keep no hidden helper that scans root/world collections for executable inclusion.
- Delete production DeriveTransportPlan(root) and TransportPlan(root) dependency from artifact/backend path.
- Delete root MaterializedProgram, AbiReadyProgram, and EmissionReadyProgram as required intermediates for interpreter backend output.
- Delete settle_effects(root).
- Delete or quarantine tests that assert old job names instead of product contracts.
- Remove temporary feature flags or dual-path shims introduced by earlier tickets.

Signal
Tests pass without the old jobs on the product-backed path. rg for the removed concepts shows no production dependency except explicitly marked legacy/test references that are justified or scheduled for removal.

Verification
cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; focused compiler2 product-path tests; cargo test --workspace unless an open ticket documents unrelated red surface.

comments.text: Compatibility scaffolding identified by fz-go4.16.8 proof: product tests still pre-settle legacy facts with drive_until_transport_plan; produce_runtime_demand_product can read a settled FactKey::RuntimeDemand; produce_transport_shape_product can exact-read a settled TransportPlan(root). Delete these with the legacy semantic/root artifact dependencies in this ticket, and switch the interpreter front door to the product-backed path.

Implemented public interp RootBackendProduct path and removed product fallbacks to settled legacy RuntimeDemand/TransportPlan. Verification: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test -q --lib compiler2_pull_; timeout tests compiler2_root_drive_timeout_reports_the_configured_limit and jsonl_backend_records_compiler2_drive_timeouts; CLI proof cargo run --quiet --bin fz2 -- --log-telemetry /tmp/fz00181-product-nodump.jsonl interp fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz. Telemetry proof: 283 compiler job starts vs checked legacy baseline 379, and zero forbidden root-artifact jobs for RootId(0). Broad cargo test -q --lib compiler2 still has related product coverage red; filed fz-go4.16.11 for remaining ReturnType fixpoint/continuation coverage instead of restoring legacy root artifact path.

title: Pull path: delete legacy semantic and root artifact dependencies
